research_topic: What is quantum uncertainty and why is it important?
scope: Single- and two-qubit uncertainty, measurement, open-system decoherence, and quantum-information performance; no claim that a universal hardware result has been observed.

claims.claim: Preparation uncertainty for incompatible observables is an intrinsic state constraint, not merely a detector limitation.
Measurement error-disturbance relations are definition sensitive and must not be conflated with the Robertson preparation relation.
Entropic uncertainty and quantum memory connect uncertainty to cryptographic and information tasks.
Decoherence and readout noise degrade device performance but do not eliminate incompatibility-based uncertainty.

prohibited_inferences: Quantum uncertainty means every measurement is technologically inaccurate.
A reported violation of a simplified error-disturbance product violates quantum mechanics or the Robertson relation.
Quantum error correction removes fundamental incompatibility or permits simultaneous sharp values of noncommuting observables.
Any electromagnetic interaction is automatically a projective measurement or an identical decoherence event.
